groups.label: AI capability exists on a spectrum of levels with increasing autonomy
groups.pov: Autonomy levels matter, but the real trap is applying them to AI that only reasons about data — every level of a copilot built on your ERP is still a System of Insight, not action. Demand L2 agents grounded in live operational constraints before you govern for scale.

competitors.what: SAP is reportedly considering cutting at least 10,000 jobs as part of a strategic shift toward AI-driven operations.
competitors.why: Large-scale restructuring signals SAP is repricing its human-delivered value proposition around AI, which affects how SAP IBP and supply chain customers think about their existing SAP investments and modernisation roadmaps — a forcing event TADA sells into.
competitors.angle: SAP replacing headcount with AI is not the same as replacing SAP with intelligence — customers still need a System of Action layer that SAP's own stack cannot provide.

competitors.what: SAP is reportedly planning to cut at least 10,000 jobs as part of a broad AI-driven restructuring of its workforce.
